auditNotes.catalogUrlChoice: Used single /shop/ as the customer-visible 100%-coverage spine (113 pages x 40 = 4518). The 30 per-category /category/ URLs in DB also cover the customer-visible set but with heavy overlap + mis-parented subcats; brand(4450)+uncategorized(424) are cross-cutting facets. CRITICAL: HTML catalog path (both /shop/ and /category/) only reaches 4518 customer-visible products. The full 11409 corpus (6891 OOS catalog-hidden) is reachable ONLY via Store API bracketed stock_status[]= or WP REST core admin REST.
auditNotes.coverageGapWarning: expectedProductCount=11409 is the FULL admin corpus, but the runtime HTML catalog crawl of /shop/ or /category/ URLs sees only 4518 (customer-visible). 5% drift gate will FAIL (4518 vs 11409 = ~60% under) unless either (a) expectedProductCount is set to the customer-visible surface 4518 to match the HTML walk, or (b) the catalog crawl/bootstrap uses the WP REST /wp/v2/product API path (admin REST is NOT stock-filtered and reaches all 11409). DB resolves this: bootstrap dataFlow discovers products via WP REST /wp/v2/product (reaches 11409) then enriches via Store API; so the DB's primary discovery is API not HTML, and expectedProductCount=11370/11411 pairs with the API discovery surface. The candidate's HTML catalogUrls are the documented fallback only.
